statement: The co-packaged optics switch platform claims 4x fewer lasers, 5x lower power consumption, 10x higher mean time between incidents and 1.3x faster time to deployment, at up to 409.6 Tb/s switching bandwidth.
why: Cutting switch power by a large factor frees megawatts inside power-capped sites, which is exactly the constraint that limits how many accelerators can be installed.

impact.mechanism: Lower switch power and fewer lasers reduce the fabric's share of a site's power and component budget, letting the same electrical envelope support more accelerators.

evidence.excerpt: Performance claims: 4x fewer lasers than conventional switches; 5x lower power consumption; 10x higher mean time between incidents; 1.3x faster time to deployment.

confidence.basis: Vendor performance claims relayed by one trade outlet; no independent benchmark.
